name: CodeElo
intro: CodeElo收录2024年5月4日至11月4日期间54场Codeforces评级竞赛中的387道题，并附带竞赛分区、题目Rating和算法标签。模型最多生成8次尝试，代码被直接提交至Codeforces官方平台，以隐藏测试、特殊/交互评测器和统一执行环境判定，再从54场比赛的人类排名估计可比较的Elo Rating。
build_method: Codeforces近期评级竞赛收集, HTML解析, 官方平台直接评测, 人类排名Elo估计
build_method_en: Recent rated Codeforces contests, HTML parsing, direct official-platform judging, human-rank Elo estimation
intro_en: CodeElo contains 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held from May 4 to November 4, 2024, with contest divisions, problem ratings, and algorithm tags. Models generate up to eight attempts, which are submitted directly to Codeforces for hidden-test, special/interactive-judge, and platform-aligned execution. Human-comparable Elo ratings are then estimated from the model's ranks across the 54 contests.
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2501.01257 Sections 2.1-2.3 and 3. CodeElo collects 387 problems from 54 rated Codeforces contests held from May 4 through November 4, 2024, excluding Div. 1-only contests. It parses problem HTML and preserves the original HTML for formulas and layout; attaches division, difficulty rating, and algorithm tags while hiding tags from models; prompts for a complete C++ solution; generates up to eight attempts; and submits parsed code directly to Codeforces. Official hidden tests, special/interactive judges, and platform time-memory limits determine acceptance. Failed attempts before success contribute penalties, model ranks are inserted among human contestants, contest-level expected ratings are solved by binary search, and ratings are averaged across 54 contests to produce human-comparable Elo plus Pass@1/2/4/8 analyses.
